title: The agentic web is here
hook_text: Tim Berners-Lee predicted autonomous AI agents.
script:
In 2001, Tim Berners-Lee published a vision for autonomous web software in Scientific American.
He called it the semantic web, an internet designed specifically for machine navigation.
Decades later, autonomous software agents are finally turning that exact concept into reality.
These programs can navigate complex websites and address your everyday tasks automatically.
Would you trust an AI agent to handle your daily browsing?
